caption: The bundled (read-only) Demo PDK row in PDK Management now offers a 'Duplicate…' button where custom PDKs have 'Edit…'.
Clicking 'Duplicate…' asks for a name for the new custom PDK, prefilled with 'Demo PDK (custom)'.
The duplicate appears immediately as a user PDK with its own 'Edit…' button — value-compatible with the foundry process, so it is enabled under the active process lock.
The per-PDK process editor opens directly on the fresh duplicate, showing the copied foundry layer stack, cross-sections and materials.
'+ Metal (electrical)' adds a metal routing cross-section to the copy — the kind of extension the read-only foundry PDK refuses.
Saving writes the extended process into the duplicate's own JSON only — the bundled foundry file stays byte-identical.
